capabilities: Generate regex, replacement and explanation from plain-language instructions via a local or hosted LLM
Preview each match before and after and apply only the checked ones
Undo an applied replacement in one step, with a vault-wide snapshot before vault runs
Refine rules with follow-up instructions and rerun saved rules from a library
Screen generated patterns for catastrophic backtracking and time them before running
disambiguation: Not a general vault-hygiene toolkit like Alchemist; it only turns a plain-language instruction into a reviewed, applied regex replacement.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+; with the optional Claude endpoint, a text sample of the scope is sent to Anthropic, while a local server keeps everything on-machine.
problem: Writing regular expressions for find-and-replace is error-prone, and Obsidian's built-in search cannot turn a plain-language description into a checked replacement.

relations.evidence: shares the alchemy/transmutation imagery but a different job: it is a general vault-hygiene toolkit

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible local server (e.g. LM Studio or Ollama)
API key for hosted or Anthropic endpoints

summary: Natural-language search and replace: a local LLM writes the regex, and every match is previewed before it is applied.
